sources.title: OpenAI is rolling out age prediction for ChatGPT consumer plans

sources.title: A Machine Learning Approach to Predict Biological Age and its ...
sources.snippet: While machine learning models can predict chronological age from biomarkers, they often fail to capture the dynamic, longitudinal nature of the aging process. In this work, we developed and validated a machine learning pipeline to predict age using a longitudinal cohort with data from two distinct time periods (2019-2020 and 2021-2022).
